goodsServices.description: Garden furniture, furniture, hampers [baskets], mirrors, picture frames; non-metallic containers in the form of bins, including compost bins; hanging baskets for plants; goods (not included in other classes) of wood, cork, reed, cane, wicker, horn, bone, ivory, whalebone, shell, amber, mother-of-pearl, meerschaum and substitutes for all these materials, or of plastics.

Mineral and aerated waters and other non-alcoholic drinks; fruit drinks and fruit juices; syrups and other preparations for making beverages; shandies.
